verdict.rationale: Glama's Gateway lets users control what an agent can do (per-tool enable/disable, access-controlled and 'credential-managed' calls) which approximates least-privilege access, but there is no explicit documentation of issuing scoped, per-agent API keys/tokens with defined permission scopes. Missing for 10: explicit API key/token issuance flow, scope definitions per credential, and any evidence of revocation or expiry controls tied to specific agents.
